time_rule: Peak-surface chronology is before K–Pg but not numerically fixed; do not set roles at 70 Ma or in 2026.
shared_constraints: three candidate manipulative digits inherited from maniraptoran-grade ancestry; specific opposition unapproved
digitigrade and feather-derived features possible for a peak-surface descendant; dimensions unapproved
an individual job or reproductive state does not prove sex, gender, caste, genotype or specialized species
no validated musculoskeletal loads, shell physiology, eye/ear organs, voices or tail mechanics
do not render these as modern members of a surviving real species

roles.title: River reader
roles.activity: Compares water level, flow cues and substrate vibration with recorded changes; not anomalous perception.
roles.functional_variation: low-contact bracing posture with deliberate environmental sampling; exact joint angles unknown
roles.testable_question: Can a candidate three-digit forelimb brace near a wet sampling fixture without requiring primate pronation?
roles.risk: Slippery flow edges and false-positive readings

roles.title: Independent observer
roles.activity: Records a second reading of the same event, explicitly allowing disagreement and measurement error.
roles.functional_variation: distinct attention and head/body orientation for parallel sampling; no unique sensory organ asserted
roles.testable_question: Can two observers record conflicting outcomes without invoking Alchul as the explanation?

roles.title: Egg-bearing individual
roles.activity: Moves between sheltered workplaces while carrying developing eggs internally at the peak-surface stage; no reproductive organ depicted.
roles.functional_variation: possible activity pacing and load redistribution; bodily shape, sex and size remain unapproved
roles.testable_question: Does assumed added load reduce clearance or support stability in actual settlement geometry?
roles.risk: Maternal gas-exchange and mobility constraints, unknown load magnitude

roles.title: Juvenile learner
roles.activity: Learns route use, materials and patterned environmental observations by watching and trying; milestone ages are unknown.
roles.functional_variation: developmental stage differs from adult; no fixed scaled adult skeleton or modern-human classroom
roles.testable_question: Do trial-and-error and repeat exposure explain learned site behaviors without inherited mystical skill?
roles.risk: Hazards from water, heat and uneven walking substrates

roles.title: Nursery caretaker
roles.activity: Coordinates protected external incubation areas, ventilation, moisture monitoring and care; not presumed egg-bearing.
roles.functional_variation: tool placement and constrained reaching across incubation surfaces; no sex-specific body morphology
roles.testable_question: Can moisture buffering coexist with gas exchange and safe access?
roles.risk: Poor ventilation, drying, overheating, cross-site contamination

roles.title: Harvest specialist
roles.activity: Studies naturally fermented plant resources, controlled storage and process variability; no invented industrial equipment.
roles.functional_variation: material sorting and three-digit handling tasks; mechanism and exact hand pads remain unknown
roles.testable_question: Are fermentation changes explainable as biology and chemistry before any anomalous interpretation is added?
roles.risk: Toxins, contamination, gas buildup, inconsistent batch conditions

program_goal: Construct a research-only working roster, not a canonical population census or game NPC character pack.
